purpose: derive, without protected data or gameplay, whether predictive statistics can be mapped honestly to product-scale safe human-trap effects

execution_boundary.allowed_raw_sessions: the exact 6400 research-exploration sessions in the frozen crossfit structure

frozen_estimator_reuse.coefficients_and_fold_standardization: load directly from the sealed readiness result

risk_estimands.primary: for an observed learner parent-D state and each A_pos action, the frozen full model probability that the opponent chooses a positional D-to-L response in the successor
risk_estimands.secondary: opponent positional WDL-tier loss for all learner tiers; W-to-D and W-to-L remain separate and are not substituted for the primary
risk_estimands.terminal_successor: risk zero because no opponent decision occurs

reference_policies.uniform_A_pos: equal probability on every A_pos action
reference_policies.geometry_A_pos: frozen out-of-fold geometry-control probabilities at the learner state, restricted to A_pos and renormalized
reference_policies.human_frequency_A_pos: frozen out-of-fold full-panel probabilities at the learner state, restricted to A_pos and renormalized
reference_policies.stochastic_reference_value: sum of reference action probability times successor risk

uplift_reporting.raw: maximum successor risk minus stochastic reference value
uplift_reporting.singleton_rule: all A_pos-cardinality-one states remain in every applicable denominator with exactly zero uplift

calibration_and_winner_correction.calibration_population: observed out-of-fold parent-D human decisions only
calibration_and_winner_correction.binning: equal unique-player-weight mass using deterministic weighted quantiles
calibration_and_winner_correction.cross_calibrator: for each held-out fold, fit an unpenalized two-parameter logistic calibration of event on logit risk using the other four out-of-fold fold rows with equal-player total weight
calibration_and_winner_correction.zero_risk_rule: exact zero predicted risk maps to exact zero and receives no prior-created event probability
calibration_and_winner_correction.corrected_uplift: select the raw-risk argmax, then evaluate both selected and reference actions through the fold-external calibration map
calibration_and_winner_correction.residual_limit: calibration shrinkage does not identify counterfactual action-specific ranking error

policy_shift_support.low_support_bin: fewer than 100 independent players or 1000 observed decisions
policy_shift_support.no_support_extrapolation: unsupported mass is reported, never assigned a global rate

tests: full-risk versus geometry-risk A_pos argmax agreement
player-balanced Pearson and Spearman association between current-state paired log-loss improvement and argmax regret
paired log-loss improvement split by argmax agreement

product_scenarios.observed_path_plug_in_upper: 0.5 times mean over side-games of min(1, sum corrected per-state D-to-L uplift)
product_scenarios.log_loss_equivalence: must be empirically tested; leave unidentified if no defensible mapping exists
product_scenarios.D_discrimination_equivalence: must be empirically tested; top-bottom discrimination is not assumed equal to policy uplift

known_biases.history_recovery_nonrandom: 1751 excluded games contain 35 draws while 92789 retained games contain 26157 draws
